files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: From trips.csv, total the fare of all trips per calendar month of started_at, ignoring empty fares. `result` should be a Series indexed by the last day of each month as a date (2025-09-30, 2025-10-31, 2025-11-30) in time order, holding the monthly totals rounded to 2 decimals.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv; sum the non-empty fares per calendar month of started_at; a Series indexed by the month's last day as a date (2025-09-30, 2025-10-31, 2025-11-30) in time order, values rounded to 2 decimals.

acceptable_variants.notes: the index may be dates, timestamps at midnight, or YYYY-MM-DD text
